title: Attackers go ‘house to house’ killing 25 villagers in central Nigeria
english: At least 25 people were killed in a brutal raid on a village located in Nigeria's Plateau state. Witnesses reported that armed attackers moved between homes targeting residents, with women and children making up the majority of those who died. Local authorities are investigating the tragedy following this targeted act of violence.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ፕላቶ ግዛት በሚገኝ አንድ መንደር በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የአይን እማኞች እንደገለጹት አጥቂዎቹ ከቤት ወደ ቤት በመሄድ ነዋሪዎችን ያጠቁ ሲሆን፣ ከተገደሉት መካከል አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ናቸው። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የታቀደ ጥቃት እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Pilaatoo kan Naayijeeriyaa keessatti, baadiyyaa tokko irratti haleellaa suukanneessaa mudateen namoonni 25 ol ta’an ajjeefamaniiru. Oddeeffannoon akka ibsutti, hidhattoonni manaa manatti deemuun namoota irratti haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta’u, miidhamtoonni hedduun isaanii dubartootaa fi daa’immanii dha. Qaamoleen nageenyaa haleellaa kana hordofee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
english: South Korea has decided to shorten its annual joint military exercises with the United States at Washington's request. President Trump pushed for the reduction to cut costs and ease tensions with North Korea, while also expressing frustration that South Korea declined to support US operations in Iran. Details regarding the specific scale of the remaining drills are still being finalized.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ መንግስት ከአሜሪካ ጋር የሚያደርገውን አመታዊ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በአሜሪካ ጥያቄ መሰረት ለማሳጠር ወስኗል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ወጪን ለመቀነስ እና ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ ደቡብ ኮሪያ በኢራን ጉዳይ ላይ ድጋፍ ባለመስጠቷ ያላቸውን ቅር መሰኘትም ገልጸዋል። የቀሩት ልምምዶች ምን ያህል እንደሚቀነሱ ዝርዝር ጉዳዮች አሁንም በውይይት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Koreen Kibbaa leenjii waraana waggaa waggaan Ameerikaa waliin taasiftu gaaffii Waashingitan hordoftee guyyoota muraasaan gabaabsuuf murteessiteetti. Pirezidaant Traamp baasii hir'isuufi hariiroo Koriyaa Kaabaa waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf yaadanii murtee kana kan dabarsan yoo ta'u, gama biraanis Koriyaan Kibbaa dhimma Iraan irratti gargaarsa waan diddeef aaruu isaanii ibsaniiru. Leenjichi hammam akka hir'atu ilaalchisee ibsi bal'aan gara fuulduraatti kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Husband and mother-in-law charged over Indian bride's death
english: Indian authorities have charged the husband and mother-in-law of model Twisha Sharma with abetment to suicide and cruelty following her death five months after marriage. The Central Bureau of Investigation concluded that persistent mental harassment drove her to end her own life, though her family initially alleged she was murdered over dowry disputes. Both accused, who have backgrounds in the legal profession, maintain their innocence and deny the charges.
amharic: የህንድ የፌደራል ፖሊስ ሞዴል ትዊሻ ሻርማ ከተጋቡ አምስት ወራት በኋላ መሞቷን ተከትሎ ባሏን እና አማቷን ራስን ማጥፋት እንዲያደርጉ በማነሳሳት እና ጭካኔ በተሞላበት ድርጊት ከሰሳቸው። ምርመራውን የሚያካሂደው የህንድ ማዕከላዊ ምርመራ ቢሮ፣ ተጎጂዋ ለከፍተኛ የሥነ ልቦና ትንኮሳ በመዳረጓ ህይወቷን እንዳጠፋች ገልጿል። ቤተሰቦቿ ለድህረ-ጋብቻ ስጦታ (dowry) ሲባል ግድያ እንደተፈጸመባት ቢከሱም፣ የሕግ ባለሙያ የሆኑት ተከሳሾቹ ግን ወንጀሉን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Indiyaa moodeela Twisha Sharma jedhamtu gaa'ela ishee erga raawwatte ji'a shan booda du'uun ishee kanneen sababa ta'an jechuun abbaa manaa ishee fi harmeewwan ishee irratti himata bane. Qorannoon biyyoolessaa Indiyaa akka ibsetti, dubartiin kun rakkina sammuu irra gahuu isheetiin of ajjeesuun ishee kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, maatiin ishee garuu qabeenya (dowry) irraa kan ka'e ajjeefamuu ishee himatanii turan. Abbaan manaa ishee fi harmeewwan ishee gocha kana akka hin raawwanne himachuun yakka irratti dhiyaate haalaniiru.

title: Bali gym owner kicks out three Israeli tourists for links to ‘IDF’
english: A gym owner located in Ubud, Bali, recently made headlines after recording a video of himself ejecting three Israeli tourists from his fitness facility. The proprietor stated that his decision to ban them was motivated by their alleged connections to the Israeli military. This incident was documented and shared by the owner across his social media platforms.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ባሊ የሚገኝ የአንድ ጂም ባለቤት ሶስት የእስራኤል ቱሪስቶችን ከአገልግሎት ውጪ በማድረግ ከስፖርት ማዘውተሪያው እንዳባረራቸው የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ለቋል። ባለቤቱ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ግለሰቦቹ ከእስራኤል መከላከያ ሠራዊት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል ምክንያት እንደሆነ አስረድቷል። የዚህ ክስተት ምስል በተለያዩ የማህበራዊ ትስስር ገፆች ላይ ተሰራጭቷል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa boqonnaa qaamaa (gym) biyya Indoneezhiyaa magaalaa Baali keessatti argamu tokko, turisoota Israa'eel sadii ta'an bakka isaatii ari'uu isaa viidiyoon ragaa ba'eera. Abbaan qabeenyichaa akka jedhetti, tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate turisootni kunneen waraana Israa'eel (IDF) waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu jechuun dha. Gochi kun viidiyoo gara miidiyaalee hawaasaatti gadhiifameen ifa ta'eera.

title: US unions sue over new visa rule for foreign students, journalists
english: A group of labor unions and advocacy organizations has filed a lawsuit to stop a new US government policy that restricts visa durations for international students, exchange visitors, and journalists. Under the new regulations, student and exchange visas are capped at four years, while media visas are severely shortened to 240 days. The plaintiffs argue that these changes will harm academic institutions and deter international talent, though government officials defend the move as a necessary measure against immigration fraud.
amharic: የሠራተኛ ማህበራት እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች በውጭ አገር ተማሪዎች፣ በልውውጥ ፕሮግራም ተሳታፊዎች እና በጋዜጠኞች ላይ አዲስ የቪዛ ገደብ የጣለውን የመንግስት ህግ በመቃወም ክስ መስርተዋል። አዲሱ ደንብ የተማሪዎችን እና የልውውጥ ጎብኝዎችን ቪዛ ቢበዛ ለአራት ዓመት፣ የጋዜጠኞችን ቪዛ ደግሞ እስከ 240 ቀናት ብቻ እንዲወሰን ያደርጋል። ከሳሾቹ ይህ ውሳኔ በትምህርት ተቋማት ላይ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስና ዓለም አቀፍ ተሰጥኦዎችን እንደሚያሳጣ ሲከራከሩ፣ የመንግስት አካላት ግን እርምጃው በስደት ስም የሚፈጸም ማጭበርበርን ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Gumiiwwan hojjettootaa fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa falman, seerawwan mootummaa US haaraa barattoota alaa, namoota jijjiirraa barnootaaf dhufan, fi gaazexeessotaaf visa daangeessu mormuun himata bananiiru. Seerichi visa barattootaa fi namoota jijjiirraa waggaa afuriin, kan gaazexeessotaa immoo guyyaa 240tti akka daangeessu ajaja. Himattoonni seerichi barnootaa fi beekumsa addunyaa irratti miidhaa akka geessisu kan ibsan yoo ta'u, mootummaan immoo tarkaanfichi soba visa irratti raawwatamu ittisuuf murteessaa dha jedhaniiru.

title: UAE imposes indefinite trade embargo on Iran over alleged missile attacks
english: The United Arab Emirates has officially placed an indefinite trade and financial ban on Iran following allegations that Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles at the country. While the UAE claims these missiles were directed at maritime traffic and threatened regional security, Iran has strongly denied the accusations, calling the incident a false flag operation. This move marks a significant escalation in tensions as the ongoing conflict in the region shows no signs of resolution.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች የኢራን ኃይሎች በሀገሪቱ ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን ተኩሰዋል በሚል ክስ በኢራን ላይ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ የሚቆይ የንግድ እና የፋይናንስ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች ሚሳኤሎቹ የባህር ላይ ትራፊክን ኢላማ ያደረጉ እና ለክልሉ ደህንነት ስጋት የፈጠሩ ናቸው ብላለች። ኢራን በበኩሏ ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ ድርጊቱ የተቀነባበረ የሀሰት ክስ ነው ስትል አስተባብላለች።
oromo: Emirates Gamtooman (UAE) humnoonni Iraan biyyattii irratti xiyyaara kombii (missile) dhukaasaniiru jechuun, gabaa fi waliigaltee maallaqa irratti dhoorkaa yeroo hin murtoofne kaa’eera. UAE akka jedhitti xiyyaarotni kun daandii galaanaarratti miidhaa geessisuuf kan qajijfaman ta’uu ibsiteetti. Iraan garuu himata kana guutummaatti haaltu, gochi kun himata sobaa fi qindaa’aa ta’uu ibsiteetti.

title: US sanctions International Criminal Court’s president and top lawyer
english: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court's president, Tomoko Akane, and prosecutor Abdoulaye Seye. Washington claims these measures are intended to shield American citizens, despite the court never having pursued charges against any US nationals. This action follows the court's ongoing investigation into potential war crimes committed by Israel in Gaza.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ቶሞኮ አካኔ እና አቃቤ ህግ አብዱላዬ ሴይ ላይ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። ዋሽንግተን እርምጃውን የወሰደችው የአሜሪካ ዜጎችን ለመከላከል በሚል ቢሆንም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ እስካሁን በአሜሪካዊያን ላይ ክስ መስርቶ አያውቅም። ይህ ማዕቀብ የተጣለው ፍርድ ቤቱ እስራኤል በጋዛ የፈጸመቻቸውን የጦር ወንጀሎች እየመረመረ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa Tomoko Akane fi abukaattoo Abdoulaye Seye irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhateera. Washington tarkaanfichi lammiilee Ameerikaa eeguuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsite, garuu manni murtichaa kanaan dura namoota Ameerikaa irratti yakka tokkollee hin himanne. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame manni murtichaa yakka waraanaa Israa'el Gaazaatti raawwatte jedhame irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jirtu keessatti.

title: Trial begins that could force Meta to change Facebook and Instagram
english: A major trial is underway in California where Meta is being accused of intentionally making Facebook and Instagram addictive for younger users. A coalition representing over half of the United States is pushing for the company to pay significant financial penalties. They are also demanding major modifications to how these social media platforms function to better protect young people.
amharic: ሜታ የፌስቡክ እና የኢንስታግራም መተግበሪያዎችን በተለይም ለወጣቶች ሱስ በሚያስይዝ መልኩ ነድፏቸዋል በሚል በካሊፎርኒያ ክስ ተመስርቶበታል። ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑ የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ኩባንያው ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ካሳ እንዲከፍል እየጠየቁ ነው። በተጨማሪም ወጣቶችን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል መድረኮቹ የሚሰሩበት መንገድ እንዲቀየር አጥብቀው እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Meta dhaabbanni jedhamu Facebook fi Instagram fayyadamtoota dargaggootaa irratti akka hirkata uuman godhee qopheesseera jedhamee California keessatti himatameera. Mootummoonni naannolee Amerikaa gurguddoon walakkaa ol ta'an kaffaltii miidhaa guddaa akka kafalu gaafachaa jiru. Kana malees, dargaggoota eeguuf jecha haalli hojii marsariitiiwwan kanaa akka jijjiiramu dhaabbilee kunneen dirqisiisaa jiru.

title: Report: Syria denies security agreement with Israel after strike on airbase
english: The Syrian government has officially dismissed reports claiming they have a security agreement with Israel. A diplomatic source stated that Israel conducted an airstrike on a military airport despite being warned that the site was empty. Syria emphasized that it will not accept any deals that restrict its national sovereignty or military development.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ ስምምነት አለ የሚለውን ወሬ በይፋ አስተባብሏል። አንድ ዲፕሎማቲክ ምንጭ እንደገለፀው እስራኤል በወታደራዊ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት የፈፀመችው ቦታው ባዶ እንደሆነ ከተነገራት በኋላ ነው። ሶሪያ የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ወይም ወታደራዊ እድገት የሚገድብ ምንም አይነት ስምምነት እንደማትቀበል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa waliigaltee nageenyaa Israa'el waliin qabaachuu isaa gabaasa dhihaate haaleera. Maddi tokko akka ibsutti, Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa waraanaa irratti haleellaa kan raawwatte iddoon sun duwwaa ta'uu akeekkachiifamtee booda dha. Suuriyaan aangoo fi guddina waraana ishee daangessu waliigaltee akkamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsiteetti.

title: Blast at major Syrian pipeline halts gas flow, disrupts power generation
english: An explosion damaged a key gas pipeline in northeastern Syria, forcing a halt to gas production from the Al-Jabsah facility and causing power supply issues. Syrian officials believe the blast was a deliberate act of sabotage rather than an accident. Fortunately, no employees were injured during the incident, and authorities are currently investigating to find those responsible.
amharic: በሰሜን ምስራቅ ሶሪያ በሚገኝ ዋና የጋዝ መስመር ላይ የደረሰ ፍንዳታ የአል-ጃብሳ የጋዝ ማምረቻ ጣቢያ ስራ እንዲቆም እና የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል አቅርቦት እንዲስተጓጎል አድርጓል። የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ፍንዳታው በአደጋ ሳይሆን ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ የጥፋት ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በክስተቱ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት ያልደረሰ ሲሆን፣ በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Siriyaa kaaba bahaatti ergaa guddaa kan ta'e diriirfama gaazii irratti dhukaatiin mudate, buufata gaazii Al-Jabsah irraa gadi lakkifamuun akka dhaabbatuu fi dhiyeessiin humna ibsaa akka addaan citu godheera. Abbootii taayitaa Siriyaatti, dhukaatiin kun balaa tasaa osoo hin taane, akeeka hamaa fi saboota kanaan kan raawwatame ta'uu amanu. Balaa kanaan hojjettoonni miidhamuu kan hin gabaafamne yoo ta'u, qaamoleen seeraa qorannoo geggeessuun qaama dhukaata kana dhaqqabsiise barbaadaa jiru.

title: Trump envoy 'deeply concerned' by Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: US special envoy for Syria, Tom Barrack, has criticized recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military base. He labeled the attack an unnecessary escalation that threatens regional stability. Barrack argued that the Syrian government has not acted aggressively and has instead sought to avoid conflict with Israel.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሶሪያ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የፈጸመችውን የአየር ጥቃት ተችተዋል። ጥቃቱ የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አላስፈላጊ እርምጃ ነው ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ባራክ የሶሪያ መንግስት ጠበኝነት እንዳላሳየ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ግጭትን ለማስወገድ እንደሚፈልግ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ergamoonni addaa kan Yuunaayitid Isteetsifi Siiriyaa, Tom Baaraak, haleellaa qilleensaarraa kan Israa'el buufata waraanaa Siiriyaa irratti raawwatte ceeqa'aniiru. Tarkaanfichi tasgabbii naannichaa kan boreesuufi barbaachisaa kan hin taaneedha jedhaniiru. Baaraak, mootummaan Siiriyaa gocha akkasii kan hin raawwanneefi Israa'el waliin walitti bu'iinsa irraa of qusachaa akka jiru ibseera.

title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada and says countries close to a deal
english: President Donald Trump has temporarily halted the implementation of a 50% tariff on Canadian imports, citing that both nations are nearing a final trade agreement. This three-day extension provides negotiators time to finalize terms that could resolve ongoing disputes over goods like dairy, automobiles, and alcohol. Additionally, the potential deal may pave the way for the reactivation of the Keystone XL oil pipeline project.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ሊጥሉት የነበረውን የ50 በመቶ የታሪፍ ጭማሪ በሶስት ቀናት አዘግይተዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት በንግድ ስምምነት መደምደሚያ ላይ መድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ ይህ እገዳ የተወሰደ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በወተት፣ በመኪና እና በአልኮል ምርቶች ላይ የነበረውን አለመግባባት ለመፍታት ጊዜ ይሰጣል። በተጨማሪም ስምምነቱ ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት የቆመውን የኬይስቶን ኤክስኤል የነዳጅ መስመር ፕሮጀክት እንደገና ለመጀመር በር ሊከፍት ይችላል።
oromo: Preezidaant Doonaald Traamp oomishaalee Kaanaadaa irra ka'uuf karoorfame ture taariffii dhibbeentaa 50 ta'e guyyoota sadiif turchiisaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame biyyoonni lameen walii galtee daldalaarratti xumura irra gahuu isaanii erga beeksisanii booda dha. Walii galtichi dhimmota akka aannan, konkolaataa fi alkoolii irratti wal dhabdee ture furuuf gargaara jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, piroojektii sagaroo boba'aa Keeyistoon Eks-El deebisanii jalqabuufis carraa uumuu danda'a.

title: Witness gets combative in Tupac murder trial - 'I don't want to send him to prison'
english: During the murder trial of Tupac Shakur, witness James McDonald gave a tense and combative testimony while refusing to identify Duane Davis as the person responsible. McDonald stated he was forced to testify under the threat of contempt, but he made it clear he did not want to be the reason Davis goes to prison. The trial continues thirty years after the rapper's death, highlighting the ongoing conflict between street codes and the legal process.
amharic: የራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩርን ግድያ በተመለከተ በተካሄደው የፍርድ ቤት ችሎት፣ ምስክሩ ጄምስ ማክዶናልድ ዱዌን ዴቪስን እንደ ወንጀለኛው ለመለየት ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኑ ውጥረት ሰፍኖ ነበር። ማክዶናልድ ምስክርነቱን እንዲሰጥ የተገደደው በፍርድ ቤት ስጋት እንደሆነ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ እሱ ዴቪስን ወደ እስር ቤት ለመላክ ፍላጎት እንደሌለው በግልጽ ተናግሯል። የቱፓክ ሻኩር ሞት ከ30 ዓመታት በኋላ እየታየ ያለው ይህ የፍርድ ሂደት፣ የወንጀል ድርጅቶች ህግ እና የሕግ የበላይነት የሚጋጩበትን ሁኔታ ያሳያል።
oromo: Murtii ajjeechaa weellisaa Tupac Shakur irratti, ragaan dhiyaatan James McDonald dubbii cimaa fi mufannaa agarsiisuun, Duane Davis akka ajjeesaa ta'etti qorattootaf himuu dide. McDonald dirqamaan akka ragaa bahu itti himamees, nama kana mana hidhaatti erguuf barbaachisaa akka hin taane ibseera. Ajjeechaan kun erga raawwatamee waggaa 30 booda kan dhiyaate yoo ta'u, kunis seera daandii (street code) fi sirna seeraa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumame kan agarsiisu dha.

title: US, Canada reach trade deal to avert steep tariffs, Trump says
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States and Canada have successfully negotiated a trade agreement, preventing the implementation of 50 percent tariffs on Canadian goods. This deal was reached just before a midnight deadline, effectively halting taxes on items like electronics, machinery, and dairy products. Additionally, Trump suggested that the Keystone XL Pipeline project might be revived as part of the ongoing discussions.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ እና ካናዳ በንግድ ስምምነት ላይ መድረሳቸውንና በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ሊጣል የነበረው የ50 በመቶ ቀረጥ መቆሙን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የተደረሰው ግብሩ በስራ ላይ ከመዋሉ ጥቂት ሰዓታት ቀደም ብሎ ሲሆን ይህም በኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ በማሽነሪዎች እና በወተት ተዋጽኦዎች ላይ ሊደርስ የነበረውን የገንዘብ ጫና አስቀርቷል። ከዚህም በላይ ትራምፕ የኪስቶን ኤክስኤል የነዳጅ ቧንቧ መስመር ፕሮጀክት እንደገና ሊጀመር እንደሚችል አመላክተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaan fi Kanaadan walii galtee daldalaa irra gahuu isaanii fi gibiri dhibbeentaa 50 ta'e kan oomishaalee Kanaadaa irratti raawwatamuuf ture akka dhaabbate ibsaniiru. Walii galtichi yeroon gibirichi itti raawwatamuuf ture sa'aatii muraasa qofa osoo hin hafin kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kunis meeshaalee elektirooniksii, maashinoota fi oomishaalee aannanii irratti qisaasama guddaa hambiseera. Kana malees, Traamp pirojektii bishaan daa'immanii ykn paayiplanii Keestoon Eks El (Keystone XL) deebi'ee jalqabamuu akka danda'u dubbataniiru.

title: US refineries taking in half of Venezuela’s oil output, official says
english: A senior US official reports that Venezuela is now exporting over 500,000 barrels of oil daily to US refineries, accounting for nearly half of its total production. This partnership utilizes US Gulf Coast facilities specifically designed to process Venezuela's heavy crude oil. Furthermore, the US is supporting this production by providing naphtha to help refine the Venezuelan oil, marking a significant increase in energy cooperation since the change in government.
amharic: አንድ ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን እንደገለጹት ቬንዙዌላ አሁን ከጠቅላላ የነዳጅ ምርቷ ግማሽ ያህሉን ወይም ከ500,000 በርሜል በላይ በቀን ወደ አሜሪካ እየላከች ነው። ይህ የንግድ ግንኙነት የአሜሪካ የባህር ዳርቻ ማጣሪያዎች የቬንዙዌላን ከባድ የድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ለማቀነባበር ያላቸውን ልዩ አቅም ይጠቀማል። ከዚህም በላይ አሜሪካ የነዳጅ ምርቱን ለማገዝ ናፍታን ወደ ቬንዙዌላ በመላክ የሁለቱን ሀገራት የኢነርጂ ትብብር አጠናክራለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, Venezueelaan amma guyyaatti baarmila 500,000 ol ta'u gara Ameerikaatti erguu irra kan jirtu yoo ta'u, kunis oomisha ishee waligalaa keessaa walakkaa ol ta'a. Walitti dhufeenyi kun qulqulleeffattoota biyya Ameerikaa kanneen boba'aa ulfaataa Venezueelaa qulqulleessuuf mijatan fayyadama. Kana malees, Ameerikaan oomisha boba'aa kana saffisiisuuf naaftaa gara Venezueelaatti erguun gargaarsa gochuufi waliin hojii humna ibsaa cimsuu irra jirti.

title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
english: Recently dismissed Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has publicly called for the resumption of national elections, arguing that the country's democratic process must continue despite the ongoing war with Russia. Fedorov, who was removed from his position following internal tensions with military leadership, criticized the current government for corruption and a lack of transparency. While President Zelensky has not officially responded, the proposal highlights significant political friction within Ukraine regarding governance during wartime.
amharic: ከስልጣናቸው የተነሱት የቀድሞ የዩክሬን መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ሚካሂሎ ፌዶሮቭ፣ አገሪቱ ከሩሲያ ጋር ጦርነት ውስጥ ብትሆንም ምርጫዎች መካሄድ እንዳለባቸው ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ፌዶሮቭ የአሁኑ መንግስት በሙስና እና በለውጥ እጥረት የተተበተበ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ የዩክሬን ዲሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት ሊቀጥል ይገባል ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል። ከወታደራዊ አመራሮች ጋር በነበራቸው አለመግባባት ከስልጣን የተባረሩት ፌዶሮቭ ያቀረቡት ይህ ሃሳብ፣ በፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ያለውን የፖለቲካ ክፍፍል ጎልቶ እንዲታይ አድርጓል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Yukreen duraanii kan aangoo irraa kaafaman Mihayiloo Fedeerov, biyyattii keessatti waraanni yoo jiraateyyuu filannoon biyyoolessaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Fedeerov mootummaan amma jiru malaammaltummaafi jijjiirama dhabuu keessa akka jiru ibsuun, sirni dimokraasii Yukreen xumuraa hanga dhumaatti itti fufuu qaba jedhaniiru. Ajajoota waraanaa waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen aangoo irraa kan kaafaman Fedeerov, yaada kana dhiheessuun isaanii mootummaa Prezidaant Zeelenski keessatti dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa uumeera.

title: How Ebola became the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak ever, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus. The crisis has resulted in over 2,300 deaths, surpassing all previous records, and is made more dangerous by the lack of specific vaccines or approved treatments. Ongoing regional conflict, community mistrust, and delayed detection of the virus have significantly hindered medical response efforts.

title: US ambassador to Israel calls settler violence ‘terror’
english: US Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, has publicly labeled violence committed by Israeli settlers against Palestinians as acts of terror. This unusual criticism comes in response to an incident where settlers besieged the home of a Palestinian-American family in the West Bank village of Qusra. The statement highlights growing international concern regarding the safety of residents in the occupied territories.

oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Haakabii, gochi haleellaa qotee bulaan Israa'el Falasxiimota irratti raawwatan shororkeessummaa dha jechuun ibsaniiru. Kanneen akkaataa itti qeeqan kanneen kan dhufan, qotee bulaan naannoo Weest Baank ganda Qusraa keessatti maatii Falasxiimii-Ameerikaa tokko mana isaanii keessatti marsanii erga turanii booda dha. title: Quebec separatist says no independence referendum while Trump in office
english: The leader of Quebec's separatist party, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, has announced that any referendum on independence will be delayed until Donald Trump is no longer US President. He believes that the current instability and unpredictability of American politics would negatively impact the quality of the independence debate. While he still intends to push for a vote if his party wins the upcoming election, it will not occur until after Trump's term ends in 2029.
amharic: የኩቤክ ነጻ አውጪ ፓርቲ መሪ የሆኑት ፖል ሴንት-ፒየር ፕላሞንዶ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት እስካሉ ድረስ የነጻነት ህዝበ ውሳኔ እንደማይካሄድ አስታውቀዋል። የአሁኑ የአሜሪካ ፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እና ያልተጠበቁ ድርጊቶች በኩቤክ የነጻነት ውይይት ጥራት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚፈጥሩ ያምናሉ። ፓርቲያቸው በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ህዝበ ውሳኔው የሚካሄደው ትራምፕ የስልጣን ዘመናቸውን በ2029 ካጠናቀቁ በኋላ ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan paartii adda ba'iinsa Quebec, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, Donald Trump hanga aangoo irraa ka'anitti sagaleen murtee bilisummaa biyyattii akka hin gaggeeffamne ibsanii jiru. Inni, siyaasni Amerikaa ammaa kun kan hin yaadatamneefi kan wal-xaxee ta'uun isaa marii bilisummaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisa jedhee amana. Paartiin isaa filannoo dhufu irratti yoo moo'ateyyuu, sagaleen murtee kun erga termiin Trump bara 2029 xumuramee booda qofa akka gaggeeffamu beeksiseera.

title: Iran’s top security official ridicules Trump’s claims over Hormuz Strait
english: A senior Iranian security official has mocked Donald Trump for stating that the Strait of Hormuz is American territory. Mohsen Rezaei dismissed the claim as baseless, highlighting the massive geographic distance and the U.S. government's lack of control in the region. He declared that these comments signal the beginning of a new era where American influence in the Persian Gulf is fading.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ባለስልጣን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት ነው ሲሉ ለተናገሩት ለዶናልድ ትራምፕ መሳለቂያ ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል። ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የአሜሪካ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ከእውነታው የራቀ እና ሀገሪቱ በክልሉ ያላትን የቁጥጥር ድክመት የሚያሳይ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ንግግር በአረብ ባህረ ሰላጤ የአሜሪካ ተጽዕኖ እያበቃ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ አዲስ ዘመን መጀመሩን ያሳያል ሲሉም አክለዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iran kan ol'aanaa ta'an, Donald Trump daandiin galaana Hormuz kan Amerikaati jechuun dubbataniif arrabsoo fi qoosannoo irratti gaggeessaniiru. Mohsen Rezaei yaada kana kan morman yoo ta'u, Amerikaa fi daandii galaanichaa gidduutti fageenya guddaan jiraachuu fi Amerikaan naannicharratti aangoo akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Yaanni Trump kun dhiibbaan Amerikaa naannoo Ganna Pershiyaa keessatti xumuramaa akka jiru kan agarsiisuudha jechuun dubbataniiru.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia is undergoing a significant political shift as proposed constitutional reforms move away from old systems of shared power toward a model based on population size. Historically, Amhara political identity was deeply connected to the state’s center, but this new approach increasingly marginalizes that influence. As the government transitions to a system where representation is determined by demographic weight, the Amhara political establishment faces a critical challenge in redefining its future role within the nation.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ አማካኝነት ከቀድሞው የጋራ የሥልጣን ክፍፍል ሥርዓት ወደ ህዝብ ቁጥር መሰረት ያደረገ የአመራር አወቃቀር በመሸጋገር ላይ ትገኛለች። በአንፃሩ የአማራ የፖለቲካ አስተሳሰብ ከኢትዮጵያ ማዕከላዊ መንግስት ጋር በጥብቅ የተቆራኘ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ አሰራር ይህንን ተፅዕኖ የመቀነስ አዝማሚያ አለው። በብልጽግና ፓርቲ የተዘረጋው የህዝብ ብዛት ተመጣጣኝ ውክልና ሥርዓት የአማራን የፖለቲካ ተዋናዮች በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ምህዳር ውስጥ ያላቸውን ሚና እንደገና እንዲያስቡ እያስገደዳቸው ይገኛል።

title: Iran war live: Trump denies Iran talks, Tehran claims US ‘begging’
english: President Donald Trump has officially dismissed reports of any ongoing or planned negotiations between the United States and Iran. Conversely, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi asserts that Washington is desperately seeking talks on Iran's terms following the failure of their pressure tactics. Tensions remain high as the U.S. continues its naval blockade while trading conflicting claims with Tehran regarding their diplomatic status.

title: Al Jazeera reports from Indonesia’s quake zone, desperate for help
english: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake has struck Indonesia's Flores Island, resulting in the deaths of at least 70 people. Thousands of residents remain displaced and are currently in urgent need of assistance. Authorities are working quickly to distribute essential supplies like food, clean water, and medical resources to the hardest-hit areas.

title: Turkey denies Israeli claims of posing a threat, says Netanyahu seeks to justify Syria strikes
english: Turkey has officially rejected Israeli claims that its military presence at a Syrian air base poses a security threat. Ankara argues that these allegations are merely an attempt by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to justify ongoing Israeli airstrikes against Syria. Turkey insists it remains committed to regional stability and urged Israel to stop its aggressive policies and follow international law.

Turkiin nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf akka hojjettu ibsuun, Israa'el siyaasa ishee kan jeequmsa fiduu fi seera idil-addunyaa akka kabajju gaafatteetti.

title: Iran’s top negotiator says Hormuz Strait will remain closed until US abides by MoU
english: Iran's chief negotiator, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, has announced that the strategic Strait of Hormuz will continue to be blocked. He stated that the waterway will only reopen once the United States fulfills its obligations under a previous agreement. A primary demand from Tehran is for the U.S. to end its current naval blockade.

title: Minnesota official sues Texas governor to force ICE agent’s extradition
english: Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is suing Texas Governor Greg Abbott to compel the extradition of ICE agent Christian Castro, who faces charges for a shooting in Minnesota. Ellison argues that the Texas governor is illegally blocking the transfer of the officer to stand trial for allegedly wounding a man and providing false statements about the incident. This case highlights ongoing concerns regarding the credibility and conduct of federal agents during past immigration enforcement operations.

title: Iraq approves three-month mechanism for crude oil exports via local, international firms
english: The Iraqi government has authorized a new plan to export crude oil using both domestic and international companies. This strategy utilizes various export points to manage shipments effectively. These new contractual arrangements are scheduled to be in place for a three-month period beginning on September 1st.

title: Bolivia arrests political adviser to Latin American right-wingers
english: Bolivian authorities have arrested Fernando Cerimedo, a political consultant known for working with various right-wing leaders, on allegations of orchestrating a murder attempt. The arrest follows an attack on activist Nadia Beller, who was shot and robbed after opposing controversial government economic reforms linked to Cerimedo. Beller, who was previously in a relationship with Cerimedo, believes she was targeted for her political activism and for exposing high-level corruption.

title: Trump administration moves to end rule protecting swaths of forest land
english: The U.S. government has proposed repealing a 2001 environmental regulation that restricted logging and road building across millions of acres of national forests. Officials argue that removing these federal protections will allow local managers to better prevent wildfires by improving forest accessibility and maintenance. However, environmental organizations oppose the move, warning that building new roads into these protected areas could actually increase the likelihood of fires and threaten local wildlife habitats.

title: Why is the US ramping up Tomahawk production?
english: The US Department of Defense has signed a major contract with Raytheon to rapidly increase the production of Tomahawk cruise missiles. Analysts suggest this move highlights concerns regarding the depletion of essential military stockpiles. This development has sparked discussions about the potential impact on global military tensions and the possibility of an intensifying international arms race.

title: Syria opens Assad-era nuclear programme to UN probe
english: Syria's current government has begun cooperating with the IAEA to investigate nuclear materials left behind by the former Bashir al-Assad regime. Inspectors recently confirmed the discovery of several tonnes of material at previously undisclosed sites, including one in Deir Az Zor. Authorities have agreed to place these materials under international supervision to ensure they are managed safely.

title: Congo Ebola outbreak ‘global emergency’ as infections pass 5,000: WHO
english: The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo a global emergency after infections surpassed 5,000. With over 2,320 deaths reported, officials note that the disease is spreading rapidly and remains difficult to control due to regional conflicts and a lack of approved treatments. Health workers are now focusing on identifying new transmission chains and engaging local community members, such as motorbike riders, to help curb the epidemic.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ከ5,000 በላይ ሰዎችን በመበከሉ ዓለም አቀፍ የጤና ድንገተኛ አደጋ መሆኑን አውጇል። ከ2,320 በላይ ሰዎች የሞቱበት ይህ ወረርሽኝ በክልሉ ባለው ግጭትና የህክምና መፍትሄዎች እጥረት ምክንያት ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች የበሽታውን ስርጭት ሰንሰለት ለመስበር እና ማህበረሰቡን ለማስተባበር እንዲሁም እንደ ሞተር ሳይክል ነጂዎች ያሉ አካላትን ለማሳተፍ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa dhibee Ebolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'ate namoota 5,000 ol waan miidheef, akka balaa fayyaa addunyaatti labseera. Namoonnii 2,320 ol du'uu kan ibsame yoo ta'u, dhibeen kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa fi qoricha gahaa dhabuu irraa kan ka'e to'achuun ulfaataa ta'eera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa babal'ina dhibee kanaa dhaabuuf, buufataaleen dhibichaa haaraa addaan baasuu fi akkasumas namoota akka ogeeyyii mootor-saayikilii fayyadamuun hawaasa bira ga'uuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Trump says no talks planned with Iran amid anger over Iran-Oman Hormuz deal
english: President Donald Trump has stated that there are no current or future negotiations planned with Iran, contradicting his previous claim of back-channel talks. He continues to maintain a naval blockade on Iranian ports while insisting the Strait of Hormuz remains open for other traffic. Meanwhile, tensions persist as Iran and Oman proceed with their own discussions on managing the waterway, despite threats from the US administration.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሁን ቀደም ከኢራን ጋር የጀርባ ድርድር እያደረጉ እንደሆነ ቢናገሩም፣ አሁን ግን ምንም አይነት የታቀደ ንግግር እንደሌለ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ወደቦችን የባህር ላይ እገዳ እንደሚቀጥሉ የገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ለሌሎች መርከቦች ክፍት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና ኦማን የስትሬቱን አጠቃቀም በተመለከተ በራሳቸው መወያየታቸውን በመቀጠላቸው፣ በአሜሪካ እና በነዚህ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp kanaan dura Irraan waliin mariin giddu-galeessa ta'e akka jiru ibsanii turanillee, amma garuu mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jirre fi fuuldurattis akka hin qophaa'in beeksisaniiru. Ibsa isaaniitiin, buufataaleen Irraan duula galaanaatiin akka ugguraman himanii, garuu daandiin galaana Hormuz markaalee birootiif banaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Gammachuu dhabuun isaanii kan mul'atu ta'us, Irraan fi Omaanni daandii kana bulchuun walitti fufaniiru, kunis mootummaa Ameerikaa waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumee jira.

title: Israeli strike reported to kill at least six in Gaza City
english: An Israeli airstrike on a crowded cafe in a Gaza City displacement camp has resulted in the deaths of at least six people and left fourteen others injured. This attack occurred amid a deadlock in peace negotiations, as Israeli leadership continues to resist ceasefire terms while Hamas demands a full military withdrawal. Mediation efforts, including a recent visit by a U.S. envoy, have failed to bridge the gap between the two sides, leaving civilians to face ongoing, unpredictable violence.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ውስጥ በምትገኝ ካፌ ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ አስራ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የተኩስ አቁም ድርድሮች ባለመሳካታቸው እና እስራኤል እና ሀማስ በተለያዩ አቋሞች ላይ በመጽናታቸው ነው። የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች የሰላም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ያደረጉት ጥረት ምንም ውጤት ሳያመጣ በመቅረቱ በሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ የሚደርሰው ጥቃት እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Magala Gaza keessatti buufata godaantotaa keessatti bakka namoonni baay'atanitti weerarri xiyyaaraa Israa'el raawwatameen namoonni 6 yoo du'an 14 immoo madaa'aniiru. Weerarri kun kan mudate mariin nagaa fi dhaabbannaan waraanaa utuu hin milkaa'in fi gamtaan lamaanuu walii galuu dadhabanii jirutti. Ergamaan tokko Gamtaan Ameerikaa nagaa buusuuf yaaliin godhe faayidaa malee hafuun isaa, namoonni nagaa weerara tasaa ta'e kanaaf saaxilamanii akka jiran agarsiisa.

title: WHO: Ebola can be contained in months if enough funding is provided
english: The World Health Organization believes the current Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of Congo can be resolved within three months. Achieving this goal depends on securing adequate funding to support necessary containment efforts. This particular outbreak is currently recognized as the most fatal in the nation's history, having already claimed over 2,300 lives.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተቀሰቀሰው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በሶስት ወራት ጊዜ ውስጥ ቁጥጥር ስር ሊውል እንደሚችል ገልጿል። ይህ የሚሳካው አስፈላጊው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እና ግብዓቶች ሲሟሉ ብቻ ነው። በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ ገዳይ የሆነው ይህ ወረርሽኝ እስካሁን ከ2,300 በላይ ሰዎችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) dhibee Ebola Rippabilika Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti mudate ji'oota sadii keessatti to'achuun akka danda'amu ibseera. Kaayyoon kun kan milkaa'u yoo deeggarsi maallaqaa fi meeshaaleen barbaachisan guutaman qofa dha. Dhibeen kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti kan hammaate fi namoota 2,300 ol ajjeeseera.

title: Israel says Syria acceptance of Turkish troops posed 'threat'
english: Israel recently launched airstrikes on an airbase in Syria after expressing concern over the Syrian government's decision to allow Turkish troops to deploy there. Israeli officials argued that this deployment violates a prior security agreement between the two nations and creates a direct threat to their interests. The Israeli government has stated that it will not accept this change and is calling for a return to the previous security status quo.

oromo: Israa'el mootummaan Siiriyaa loltoota Tarkii buufata xiyyaaraa ishee keessatti akka qubataniif hayyamuun isaa nageenya ishee irratti soda akka uumu ibsuun buufata xiyyaaraa Siiriyaa irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti. Mootummaan Israa'el qubachiifni loltoota Tarkii kun waliigaltee nageenyaa kanaan dura biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ture cabsuu fi nageenya ishee irratti balaa akka qabu ibsiteetti. Israa'el haala kanaan dura ture malee jijjiirama kana akka hin fudhanne beeksisuun, haalli nageenyaa gara duriitti akka deebi'u gaafatteetti.

title: UN says only 3 percent of Gaza’s cropland remains accessible and undamaged
english: A recent UN report reveals that nearly all of Gaza’s farmland has been destroyed or rendered unusable due to the ongoing conflict. Out of the total agricultural land, only 3 percent remains both reachable and in good condition. This sharp decline is largely caused by the expansion of military-restricted zones, which prevents farmers from tending to their crops.

oromo: Gabaasni Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka mul'isutti, lafti qonnaa Gaaza keessa jiru hedduun isaa waraana kanaan miidhamee fi itti fayyadamuun kan hin danda'amne ta'eera. Lafti qonnaa guutuu keessaa dhibbeentaa sadii qofatu amma iyyuu dhaqqabamaa fi miidhaan irra hin ga'in jira. Hir'inni lafa qonnaa kunis kan mudate, qonnaan bultoonni lafa isaanii akka hin qotanne daangaan waraanaa waan bal'ateefidha.

title: Iran rejects UAE statement on missile launches originating from Iran
english: The Iranian government has formally denied allegations made by the UAE regarding responsibility for recent ballistic missile attacks on its maritime territory. While the UAE blamed Iran for the strikes and responded by suspending all trade, Tehran dismissed these claims as completely unfounded. This diplomatic dispute has led to a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations.

oromo: Mootummaan Iraan haleellaa mishaayilii daangaa galaana UAE irratti raawwatame jedhamee himatame hunda sirritti haaleera. UAE haleellaa kanaan Iraan akka himatamtu ibsuun, hanga ibsa biraatti daldala biyyattii waliin qabdu hunda dhaabdeetti. Iraan himannaa UAE dhiyaate kana ragaa kan hin qabne fi dhugaa irraa kan fagaate jechuun cimsitee balaaleffatteetti.

title: US Justice Department targets Iranian institute for activity linked to IRGC
english: The U.S. Department of Justice has charged 17 individuals from Iran's Mabna Institute for conducting a massive cyber-espionage campaign. This group allegedly worked for the Iranian Revolutionary Guard to steal over 31 terabytes of academic and intellectual data from hundreds of universities, companies, and government agencies globally. The unauthorized hacking activity, which targeted over 100,000 accounts, caused more than $20 million in damages.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በኢራኑ ማብና ኢንስቲትዩት ላይ በሳይበር ጥቃት የተሳተፉ 17 ግለሰቦችን ከሰሰ። ቡድኑ የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኞችን ወክሎ በመስራት በመቶዎች በሚቆጠሩ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች፣ ኩባንያዎች እና የመንግስት ተቋማት ላይ የሳይበር ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ከ31 ቴራባይት በላይ የምርምር እና የባለቤትነት መረጃዎችን ሰርቋል። ከ100,000 በላይ መለያዎችን ያነጣጠረው ይህ ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት ከ20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ አስከትሏል።
oromo: Manni Maree Haqaa Amerikaa namoota 17 kan dhaabbata Mabnaa kan Iran irraa ta'an irratti himata bane. Gareen kun garee eegduu qabeenya mootummaa Iran (IRGC) bakka bu'uudhaan, yunivarsiitiiwwan, dhaabbilee daldalaa fi gamoowwan mootummaa addunyaa irraatti duula saaybar biroo gaggeessuun odeeffannoo fi qorannoo hedduu hataniiru. Duulli saaybar kun herrega nama 100,000 ol irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, miidhaa tilmaamaan doolaara miiliyoona 20 ol ta'u geessiseera.

title: Israel issues tender for 1,234 settlement units in occupied Jerusalem
english: Israel has officially opened bidding for the construction of 1,234 new housing units in the E1 area east of occupied Jerusalem. This move transitions a highly debated project from the planning phase into actual implementation. The development encompasses significant land spanning residential, industrial, and tourism infrastructure between Jerusalem and Ma'ale Adumim.
amharic: እስራኤል በተያዘችው የኢየሩሳሌም ምስራቃዊ ክፍል 1,234 አዳዲስ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ ማውጣቷን አስታውቃለች። ይህ እርምጃ ለረጅም ጊዜ ውዝግብ ሲያስነሳ የቆየውን የኢ1 ፕሮጀክት ከዕቅድ ደረጃ ወደ ተግባራዊ የግንባታ ምዕራፍ ያሸጋግረዋል። ፕሮጀክቱ በኢየሩሳሌም እና በማሌ አዱሚም መካከል የሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን፣ የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከላትን እና የቱሪዝም መሰረተ ልማቶችን ያካተተ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el gamoo jireenyaa 1,234 ta'an naannoo Yerusaalem qabamteetti argamu gara bahaatti ijaaruuf carraa hojii ifatti labsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun sagantaa E1 jedhamuufi yeroo dheeraaf mormii guddaa kaasaa ture, sadarkaa karooraarraa gara ijaarsaatti akka ce'u taasisa. Pirojektichi lafa bal'aa Yerusaalem fi Ma'ale Adumim gidduu jiru irratti giddugaleessa jireenyaa, warshaalee fi bakka turizimii ijaaruuf kan qophaaye dha.

title: Russia reports Ukrainian drone strike near Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant
english: A drone strike near the Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant in Ukraine resulted in the death of one specialist and injured 17 staff members at a bus stop. While the International Atomic Energy Agency confirmed no direct damage to the facility's nuclear safety systems, they condemned the attack for endangering personnel and risking a potential disaster. Russian officials blamed Ukraine for the strike, which occurred just before a planned visit by the head of the UN's nuclear watchdog.
amharic: በዩክሬን በሚገኘው የዛፖሪዝሂያ የኑክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት አንድ ባለሙያ ሲገደሉ 17 ሠራተኞች ቆስለዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኑክሌር ጠባቂ ድርጅት በጣቢያው የኑክሌር ደህንነት ላይ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ ቢያረጋግጥም፣ ጥቃቱ በሠራተኞች ላይ አደጋ በመጣሉ እና የኑክሌር ስጋት በመፍጠሩ ድርጊቱን አውግዟል። የሩሲያ አስተዳደር ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ዩክሬን እንደሆነች ሲገልጽ፣ ድርጊቱ የተፈጸመው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኑክሌር ኤጀንሲ ኃላፊ በጣቢያው ጉብኝት ለማድረግ በነበሩበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Buufata anniisaa niwukileraa Zaporizhzhia kan Raashiyaan qabamee jiru cinaatti miilaan lafaa ykn droniin haleellaa raawwatamee tokko ajjeesee kudha torba immoo mii'eessera. Dhaabbanni anniisaa niwukileraa idil-addunyaa (IAEA) buufaticharratti miidhaan niwukileraa akka hin geenyee fi nageenyi isaa eegamee akka jiru ibseera; ta'us, haleellaa kana namarratti raawwatamee fi balaa guddaaf saaxiluu isaa balaaleffateera. Mootummaan Raashiyaa haleellaa kana kan raawwate Yukreen akka taate himataa jiru, kunis yeroo duraan hooggansaan IAEA daawwannaa taasisuuf qophaa'aa turanitti ta'uun gabaasameera.

title: Liberia to take 1,200 deportees from the US
english: Liberia has reached an agreement with the United States to accept up to 1,200 migrants for deportation, the largest deal of its kind under the current administration's third-country policy. The first group of 20 individuals, who are not Liberian nationals, is expected to arrive shortly with full freedom to leave the country as they wish. While the U.S. has provided financial incentives and visa extensions to Liberia in exchange for this cooperation, the policy is currently facing several legal challenges.
amharic: ላይቤሪያ ከአሜሪካ የሚባረሩ እስከ 1,200 ስደተኞችን ለመቀበል ከተስማማች በኋላ የመጀመሪያው የ20 ሰዎች ቡድን በቅርቡ ወደ ሀገሪቱ ይገባል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። እነዚህ በዋናነት የአፍሪካ፣ የአሜሪካ እና የካሪቢያን ሀገራት ዜጎች ሲሆኑ፣ ወደ ላይቤሪያ ሲገቡ እንደ እንግዳ የሚስተናገዱ እና የፈለጉ ጊዜ ሀገሪቱን ለቀው የመውጣት መብት ይኖራቸዋል። አሜሪካ ይህንን ስምምነት ለማሳካት ለላይቤሪያ የጤና አገልግሎት ድጋፍ እና የቪዛ ማራዘሚያዎችን ብትሰጥም፣ ስምምነቱ በአሜሪካ ውስጥ በተለያዩ ክሶች እየተፈታተነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Laayibeeriyaan namoota 1,200 ta'an kanneen Ameerikaarraa ari'aman biyya ishee akka keessummeessitu mootummaa Ameerikaa waliin walii galtee uumteetti. Gareen namoota 20 ta'an jalqabaa torban kana kan seenan yoo ta'u, namoonni kunneen biyyoota garaa garaa irraa kan dhufan ta'us, bilisummaan biyya san keessa jiraachuu fi yeroo barbaadan biyyattii gadi lakkisuuf mirga qabu. Ameerikaan walii galtee kanaaf jecha deeggarsa fayyaa fi carraa viizaa dheereessuu keniteefii kan jirtu yoo ta'u, ta'us walii galteen kun himannaa seeraa hedduun mudachaa jira.

title: Russian missile strike kills 10 civilians in Kharkiv
english: A Russian missile attack on the Pechenihy area of Ukraine's Kharkiv region resulted in at least 10 civilian deaths and 17 injuries. The assault involved two separate strikes that targeted a local cafe and a parking lot near a service station. The blasts caused significant destruction to nearby residences, businesses, and vehicles.
amharic: በዩክሬን ካርኪቭ ክልል በፔቼኒሂ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 10 ንፁሃን ዜጎች ተገድለዋል፤ 17 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በሁለት ተከታታይ ምቶች ሲሆን የሀገር ውስጥ ካፌንና የአገልግሎት መስጫ ጣቢያ ማቆሚያን ያነጣጠረ ነበር። በቦታው የነበሩ መኖሪያ ቤቶች፣ ሱቆችና ተሽከርካሪዎችም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa naannoo Kharkiv kan Yukreen, magaalattii Pechenihy irratti miisaayiliin haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni nagaa 10 yoo du'an, 17 immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun walitti aansuudhaan kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kaafii fi iddoo konkolaataan itti dhaabatu kan miidhe dha. Haleellaa kanaan mana jireenyaa, suuqotaa fi konkolaatonni naannichaa miidhaa guddaaf saaxilamaniiru.

title: Trump and Carney speak ahead of US tariff deadline
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and US President Donald Trump recently held discussions to address an upcoming deadline for new 50 percent tariffs on Canadian imports. These trade levies, which could impact $20 billion in goods and threaten regional jobs, are currently the subject of intense negotiations. The two leaders are struggling to resolve disagreements over automotive trade rules and the definition of local content in manufacturing.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እና የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ሊጣል የታቀደውን የ50 በመቶ የታሪፍ ቀረጥ ለመወያየት በስልክ ተነጋግረዋል። ይህ የታሪፍ ውሳኔ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የንግድ ልውውጥን የሚነካ እና የስራ እድሎችን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል በመሆኑ ድርድሩ በአስቸኳይ እየተካሄደ ነው። ሁለቱ ሀገራት በተለይ በተሽከርካሪዎች ንግድ ደንቦች እና በአምራች ክፍሎች ምንጭ ላይ ባላቸው አለመግባባት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii fi Preezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp, gibira dabalataa dhibbeentaa 50 ta’u kan Kaanaadaa irratti fudhatamuuf jedhu ilaalchisee mari’ataniiru. Gibirri kun gabaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti argamu doolaara biliyoona 20 oliin tilmaamamu kan miidhu fi carraa hojii irratti dhiibbaa kan geessisu dha. Mootummoonni lameen marii cimaa gaggeessaa jiranis, addatti seera gurgurtaa konkolaataa fi meeshaalee oomishaa irratti waliigalteerra gahuuf wal dhabuun isaanii ibsameera.

title: US sanctions International Criminal Court president and trial lawyer
english: The Trump administration has imposed sanctions on International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane and senior lawyer Abdoulaye Seye as part of an effort to dismantle the institution. These measures freeze the officials' American assets and restrict their ability to conduct financial transactions, citing concerns over judicial overreach regarding the U.S. and Israel. The ICC has condemned these actions, warning that targeting legal professionals undermines the rule of law and international judicial independence.

oromo: Mootummaan Donald Trump, Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) laaffisuuf yaadamee, pirezidaantii mana murtichaa Tomoko Akane fi abukaattoo olaanaa Abdoulaye Seye irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhateera. Sanadoonni kun qabeenya namoota kanaa kan akka Ameerikaatti jiru kan qabu yoo ta'u, akkaataa itti gurgurtaa ykn guddifannaa maallaqaa fayyadamuu danda'an irratti daangaa kaa'a. Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa, tarkaanfiin kun bulchiinsa seeraa fi bilisummaa abbootii seeraa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsuun balaaleffateera.

title: US Justice Department denies whistleblower claims on anti-Semitism probes
english: A former Department of Justice lawyer has accused the Trump administration of orchestrating politically motivated investigations into Ivy League universities regarding allegations of anti-Semitism. The whistleblower claims these probes lacked factual evidence and that officials pressured schools into settlements for political gain. In response, the Department of Justice rejected these allegations, asserting that the individual in question was not involved in those specific university investigations.
amharic: የቀድሞ የፍትህ ዲፓርትመንት ጠበቃ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በአይቪ ሊግ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ላይ ያደረገው የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ምርመራ በፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎት የተቃኘ እንደነበር ከሰሱ። አቅራቢው ምርመራው በቂ ማስረጃ ያልነበረው እና መንግስት ለፖለቲካዊ ጥቅሙ ሲል ትምህርት ቤቶችን ለስምምነት ያስገደደበት መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። የፍትህ ዲፓርትመንቱ በበኩሉ ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ ግለሰቧ በእነዚህ የምርመራ ሂደቶች ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ተሳትፎ እንዳልነበራት አስታውቋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa duraanii tokko bulchiinsi Trump yunivarsitiiwwan gurguddoo irratti qorannoo 'anti-semitism' jedhu kan gaggeesse siyaasa irratti hundaa'uun akka ta'e himateera. Himataan kun qorannoon sun ragaa gahaa akka hin qabneefi mootummaan faayidaa siyaasaatiif jecha yunivarsitiiwwan akka waliigalan dhiibbaa gochaa akka ture ibseera. Kutaansaa murtii (Department of Justice) garuu himannaa kana haaluun, namichi kun qorannoo yunivarsitiiwwan irratti hirmaannaa tokkollee akka hin qabne beeksiseera.

title: Syrian petroleum company says explosion of gas pipeline 'deliberate act of sabotage'
english: A gas pipeline at Syria's Al-Jabsah plant was damaged by an explosion, forcing a temporary shutdown of oil transport. Officials reported that early findings suggest the blast was a targeted act of sabotage rather than an accident. Fortunately, no staff members were harmed during the incident.
amharic: በሶሪያ አል-ጃብሳህ የጋዝ ፋብሪካ በተከሰተ ፍንዳታ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር አገልግሎት ተቋርጧል። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለፁት፣ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው ፍንዳታው ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ የጥፋት ድርጊት ነው። በዚህ አደጋ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት አልደረሰም።
oromo: Buufata gaazii Al-Jabsah kan Siiriyaa keessatti miidhaan gaazii fi boba'aa geessisu irra ga'een hojiin ergaa boba'aa dhaabbatee jira. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, dhuka'ichi gocha hammeenyaa kan ta'e malee balaa tasaa miti. Balaa kanaan hojjettoota irra miidhaan qaamaa akka hin ga'in ibsameera.

title: Turkish politician Melih Meric stabbed
english: Turkish politician Melih Meric was hospitalized for emergency surgery after being stabbed during an altercation. The incident was captured on video, showing the New Party MP in a heated dispute with his attacker. Reports identify the assailant as Seydi Ahmet Keles, a former leader within the Republican People’s Party.
amharic: የቱርክ ፖለቲከኛ ሜሊህ ሜሪች በካሜራ በተቀረጸ ግጭት ወቅት በቢላ ተወግተው ለድንገተኛ ቀዶ ጥገና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። የኒው ፓርቲ አባል የሆኑት ሜሪች ጥቃት የደረሰባቸው ከአንድ ሰው ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ነው። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው የቀድሞው የሪፐብሊካን ህዝባዊ ፓርቲ መሪ ሰይዲ አህመት ኬለስ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Siyaasaa biyya Turkii kan ta'an Melih Meric, walitti bu'insa namoota gidduutti uumameen erga waraananii booda gara hospitaalaatti geeffamaniiru. Namni kun kan waraane inniis dura taa'aa paartii Republican People's Party kan turan Seydi Ahmet Keles akka ta'e gabaasni ni ibsa. Melih Meric paartii haaraa 'New Party' irraa miseensa ta'aniiru.

title: US seeks to revive criminal case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia
english: The U.S. government is challenging a judge's decision to dismiss criminal charges against Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran man who was previously deported by mistake. A federal judge had earlier dropped the case, labeling the government's prosecution as a retaliatory act meant to cover up their error. Federal prosecutors are now arguing that this ruling was incorrect and are attempting to move forward with the trafficking charges against him.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ቀደም ሲል በስህተት ተባርሮ የነበረውን የሳልቫዶር ዜጋ ኪልማር አብሬጎ ጋርሲያ ላይ ቀርበው የነበሩ የወንጀል ክሶች እንዲቀጥሉ ፍርድ ቤቱን እየጠየቀ ነው። ከዚህ ቀደም የፌዴራል ዳኛ መንግስት በሰውየው ላይ ክስ የመሰረተው ስህተታቸውን ለመሸፈን በሚል የበቀል እርምጃ ነው በማለት ክሱን ውድቅ አድርገውት ነበር። አቃቤ ህጎች የዳኛውን ውሳኔ በመቃወም በአብሬጎ ጋርሲያ ላይ የተመሰረተው የሰዎች ዝውውር ክስ በህጋዊ መንገድ እንዲቀጥል እየተከራከሩ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhimma Kilmaar Abreego Gaarsiyaa jedhamuu fi kanaan dura dogoggoraan biyyatti deebifamee ture irratti himannaa yakkaa akka haaromsuuf manni murtii gaafateera. Kanaan dura abbaan murtii tokko, mootummaan namicha kana irratti himannaa dhiheessuun isaa hammeenyaa fi baasii sodaachisuuf kan godhame akka ta'e ibsuun himannicha akka gadi dhiifamu ajaje ture. Amma abbaan alangaa federaalaa murtee kana mormuun, himannaan nama deddeebisuu (human trafficking) irratti baname akka itti fufuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: US mulls shrinking military footprint in Gulf as a result of war on Iran: Report
english: The U.S. government is currently reviewing its military presence in the Gulf following recent attacks by Iran on American bases. Officials are considering reducing the number of troops and may decide against fully restoring facilities that were damaged during the conflict. This reassessment is viewed by defense leaders as a significant opportunity to adjust their long-standing strategic footprint in the region.
amharic: በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት እንደተጠበቀ ሆኖ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ያለውን የወታደራዊ ኃይል መጠን ለመቀነስ እያሰበ ነው። በኢራን የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች የደረሰባቸውን ወታደራዊ መሠረቶች ሙሉ ለሙሉ ላለመጠገን አማራጮች እየታዩ ነው። ይህ ሂደት ፔንታጎን በአካባቢው ያለውን የረዥም ጊዜ ወታደራዊ አቀማመጥ እንደገና ለመገምገም እንደ ትልቅ ዕድል እየተመለከተው ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa waraana Iraan waliin taasisaa jiru hordofee, buufataalee waraana isaa kanneen naannoo Gulf jiran xiqqeessuuf mari'achaa jira. Miidhaan buufataalee waraanaa irra ga'e deebi'ee akka hin ijaarramne fi baay'inni waraanaa akka hir'atuuf yaada dhiyaateera. Phentaagoniin tarkaanfii kana akka carraa gaariitti ilaaluun, humna waraanaa naannichatti qabu ilaalchisee tarsiimoo isaa haaraatti bocaadhee jira.

title: France to expel two Iranian diplomats in coming days, foreign minister says
english: France has announced the upcoming expulsion of two Iranian diplomats following a heated diplomatic standoff. This decision follows Iran's refusal to permit two French embassy staff members to return to the country after they were reportedly detained and intimidated by Iranian security forces in July. Tensions between the two nations continue to escalate amid ongoing regional instability.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል በተፈጠረው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውዝግብ ምክንያት ሁለት የኢራን ዲፕሎማቶችን ከሀገሯ እንደምታባርር አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ኢራን በሐምሌ ወር በቴህራን የታሰሩ እና እንግልት የደረሰባቸው ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ኤምባሲ ሰራተኞች ወደ ሀገሯ እንዳይመለሱ ከከለከለች በኋላ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ሳቢያ ይበልጥ እየተካረረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Faransaayiin walitti buiinsa dippiloomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumameen walqabatee dippiloomaatonni Iraan lama akka biyyattii gadi lakkisan beeksifteerti. Murtoon kun kan dhufe, hojjattoonni embaasii Faransaayi lama kanneen ji'a darbe Teheran keessatti qabamanii fi miidhaan irra ga'e, gara Iraanitti akka hin deebine mootummaan Iraan erga dhoorkee booda. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota kana lamaanii sababa naannawaa sana keessatti mul'atuun cimaa dhufeera.

title: Iranian-American comedian Max Amini sparks backlash over 'species' remarks on Iranian people
english: Iranian-American comedian Max Amini is facing significant online backlash for dehumanizing comments made during an appearance on Bill Maher's podcast. Amini claimed that those fighting against the US and Israel are a different 'species' lacking morals, distinguishing them from the general Iranian population. Many social media users have criticized these remarks as harmful generalizations that justify violence and ignore the suffering of ordinary civilians.
amharic: የኢራን እና የአሜሪካ ተወላጅ የሆነው ኮሜዲያን ማክስ አሚኒ በቢል ማሄር ፖድካስት ላይ በተናገራቸው አወዛጋቢ ንግግሮች ከፍተኛ ትችት እየደረሰበት ነው። አሚኒ ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚዋጉትን ሰዎች ምንም ዓይነት የሞራል ስሜት የሌላቸው የሌላ ዝርያ ተወካዮች በማለት መግለጹ ብዙዎችን አስቆጥቷል። በርካታ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተጠቃሚዎች ይህ አባባል ኢራናውያንን የሚያዋርድ እና በሲቪል ሰዎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት የሚያበረታታ ነው በማለት ኮንነውታል።
oromo: Komiidiyaaniin lammii Amerikaa fi Iraan Max Amini, sagantaa Bill Maher irratti haasawa inni godheen kan ka'e komii cimaan irratti dhiyaachaa jira. Amini namoota Amerikaa fi Israa'el wajjiin lola irra jiran 'baayoloojii' ykn gosoota addaa kanneen amala hin qabne jechuun ibsuun isaa baay'ee mufachiiseera. Fayyadamtoonni miidiyaa hawaasaa hedduun haasawa kana akka waan namoota Iraan gadi qabuufi tarkaanfii waraanaa irratti fudhatamuuf sababa ta'utti fudhachuun itti mormaniiru.

title: The ‘witch-hunt’ of Jason Arday
english: Jason Arday, who became Cambridge University’s youngest Black professor, recently passed away following a brief period of intense public scrutiny. Before his death, he faced and consistently denied allegations of plagiarism that sparked a major media controversy. A vigil was held in London to honor his memory and legacy.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ትንሹ ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩት ጄሰን አርዳይ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ከሕልፈታቸው በፊት በፕላጂያሪዝም ወይም በሌላ ሰው ሥራ ስርቆት ወንጀል ተከሰው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ መሆኑን ሲገልጹ ቆይተዋል። በለንደን ለክብራቸው የተደረገ መታሰቢያ ሥነ-ሥርዓት ተካሂዷል።
oromo: Pirofesara guddicha Yuunivarsitii Kaambirij kan ta'an Jeeson Arday erga gabaabaa booda du'aan addunyaa kanarraa darbaniiru. Du'a isaanii dura, yakka hatattamaa (plagiarism) irratti himatamanii turan, ta'us himata kana guutummaatti haalanii turan. Magaalaa Landanitti yaadannoon isaaniif taasifameera.

title: US judge says government can revoke deportation protections for Ethiopians
english: A U.S. federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration is allowed to end Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for over 5,000 Ethiopian nationals. This decision follows a Supreme Court ruling that reduced the power of courts to challenge the government's authority to cancel these deportation protections. As a result, the administration can now move forward with plans to remove TPS protections for citizens from Ethiopia and several other countries.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከ5,000 በላይ ለሚሆኑ ኢትዮጵያውያን ተሰጥቶ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ የጥበቃ ሁኔታ (TPS) እንዲሰርዝ መፍቀዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የወጣው ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ መንግስት እነዚህን የጥበቃ መብቶች የመሰረዝ ስልጣኑን እንዲገድቡ ፍርድ ቤቶች ያላቸውን አቅም ከቀነሰ በኋላ ነው። በውሳኔው መሰረት፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢትዮጵያ እና ከሌሎች በርካታ ሀገራት ለመጡ ስደተኞች ሲሰጥ የነበረውን የጥበቃ መብት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመሰረዝ ሂደቱን መቀጠል ይችላል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Trump lammiilee Itoophiyaa 5,000 ol ta'aniif eeyyama yeroo turtiif kenname (TPS) akka haqu murteesseera. Murtiin kun kan dhufe Mana Murtii Waliigalaa Ameerikaa eeyyama kana haquuf aangoo mootummaan qabu irratti gita gaaffii kaasuun akka hin danda'amne erga murteesseen booda. Bu'aa kana hordofuudhaan, mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiilee Itoophiyaa fi biyyoota biroo kanneen TPS qaban irratti tarkaanfii gaggeessuu ni danda'a.

title: US envoy calls out Israeli settler 'terrorism' in interview
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has publicly labeled the actions of Israeli settlers in the West Bank as terrorism. During an interview, he explained that their efforts to intimidate local populations and force behavioral changes meet the dictionary definition of the term. This statement follows his recent condemnation of a specific settler siege that targeted residents in the village of Qusra.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር በእስራኤል ማይክ ሀካቢ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎችን ድርጊት አሸባሪነት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። በአንድ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ፍርሃትን በመፍጠር ባህሪያቸውን ለመቀየር የሚወስዱት እርምጃ የአሸባሪነትን ትርጉም የሚያሟላ ነው። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው በኩስራ መንደር ላይ የተፈጸመውን የሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ከበባ ካወገዙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Hakabii, gochaa qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti raawwatan 'shororkeessummaa' jechuun ibsan. Hagabii gaaffii fi deebii taasisaniin, qubattoonni kun ummata sodaachisuun akkaataa jireenya isaanii jijjiiruuf yaaluun isaanii hiika shororkeessummaa kan guutu ta'uu ibsan. Ibsi kun kan kenname, qubattoonni baadiyaa Qusraa keessatti manneen jiraattotaa marfanii turan erga balaaleeffatanii boodadha.

title: Trump envoy 'deeply concerned' by Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: US special envoy for Syria, Tom Barrack, has criticized recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military base, labeling them an unnecessary escalation that threatens regional stability. While Israel has not officially claimed responsibility, Barrack blamed the country for the attack following discussions with Syrian officials. The Syrian government condemned the strikes, arguing that Israel's actions are driven by expansionist motives rather than genuine security concerns.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሶሪያ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በመቃወም፣ ድርጊቱ ለቀጠናው መረጋጋት የማይጠቅም እና አላስፈላጊ ውጥረት የሚፈጥር ነው ብለዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን በይፋ ባታምንም፣ የአሜሪካው መልዕክተኛ ከሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ ጥቃቱ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የሶሪያ መንግስት ጥቃቱን ያወገዘ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል እንቅስቃሴ ከጸጥታ ስጋት ይልቅ መስፋፋትን ያለመ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Ergamtuun addaa Ameerikaa kan Siiriyaa, Tom Barrack, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'el buufata waraanaa Siiriyaa irratti raawwatte balaaleffataniiru. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii naannichaa kan boorreesse fi barbaachisaa kan hin taane akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Israa'el haleellaa kana raawwachuu ishee ifatti kan hin mirkaneessine ta'us, hoggantoonni Siiriyaa waliin erga mari'atanii booda itti gaafatamummaan kan Israa'el ta'uu eeraniiru. Mootummaan Siiriyaa haleellaa kana kan balaaleffate yoo ta'u, gochi Israa'el kun sodaa nageenyaa irra darbee fedhii lafa babal'ifachuu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibseera.

title: ICC says US sanctions 'undermine the rule of law'
english: The International Criminal Court has criticized the United States for imposing sanctions on its senior officials, stating that such actions threaten the global legal system. The court argues that targeting judicial figures for performing their duties weakens the rule of law. Despite this pressure, the ICC affirmed that it remains committed to its mission and continues to support its staff.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በከፍተኛ ባለስልጣኖቹ ላይ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ተችቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ እርምጃ አለም አቀፍ የህግ ስርዓትን የሚፈታተን መሆኑን ገልጿል። ዳኞች ስራቸውን በመስራታቸው ምክንያት ሲፈራረጁ ህግ የማስከበር ሂደቱ አደጋ ላይ እንደሚወድቅ የገለጸው ፍርድ ቤቱ፣ በስራው እንደሚቀጥልም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa (ICC) mootummaan Ameerikaa hoggantoota isaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhate balaaleffateera. Tarkaanfiin kun sirna seeraa addunyaa miidhuu danda'a jedheera. Abbootii seeraa hojii isaanii raawwataniif sodaachisuun seera kabachiisuu irratti dhiibbaa akka qabu ibsuun, manni murtichaa hojii isaa daran cimsee itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: Houthi ballistic missile hits house near Yemen’s Taiz
english: A Houthi-fired ballistic missile struck a residential home in the village of al-Akmah, located in Yemen's Maqbanah district. The explosion resulted in significant property damage and the death of several animals owned by the family. Fortunately, no people were harmed in the incident.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ታኢዝ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው አል-አክማ መንደር ላይ ባደረሱት የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት አንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ተመታ። ጥቃቱ በቤቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በርካታ የቤት እንስሳት እንዲሞቱ አድርጓል። ሆኖም በሰዎች ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Miseensota garee Huutii kanneen Yaman, naannoo Ta’izitti bakka al-Akmah jedhamutti roobsaniin boombiin balistii mana jireenya tokko rukutee jira. Miidhaan qabeenyaa guddaan mana sana irra ga’eera, akkasumas horiin garaa garaa du’aniiru. Haata’u malee, balaa kanaan namni tokkollee du’e ykn miidhame hin jiru.

title: US mulls shrinking military footprint in Gulf as a result of war on Iran: Report
english: The US government is considering reducing its military presence in the Gulf region due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. Defense officials are concerned about the vulnerability of existing bases to Iranian drone and missile strikes. Consequently, the Pentagon is evaluating whether to relocate these forces to more secure locations to better protect military assets.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ያለውን ወታደራዊ መገኘት ለመቀነስ እያሰበ ነው። የመከላከያ ባለስልጣናት ነባር የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈሮች ለኢራን የድሮን እና የሮኬት ጥቃቶች ተጋላጭ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት የፔንታጎን ሰራዊቱን ይበልጥ ደህንነታቸው በተጠበቁ አካባቢዎች ለማዘዋወር እያጤነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa walitti bu’iinsa biyyattii fi Iraan gidduutti uumameen walqabatee, naannoo Gulf jedhamutti humna waraanaa ishee hir’isuuf karoora qabachaa jirti. Hojjettoonni ittisa biyyaa buufataalee waraanaa ammaa kun xiyyara malee balaliitotaa fi madooyyii Iraaniin rukutamuuf saaxilamoo ta’uu isaanii yaadda’u. Kanaafuu, Pentagon-ni meeshaalee waraanaa fi loltoota isaa bakka tasgabbaa’aa ta’etti jijjiiruuf mari’achaa jira.

title: Landmark trial on Meta’s impact on children’s mental health begins in US
english: A major legal trial has begun in the United States where 29 states are accusing Meta of designing Facebook and Instagram to intentionally addict young users and negatively impact their mental health. The states claim the company prioritizes profit by keeping children engaged while illegally gathering data from minors. Meta has denied these accusations, arguing that they have implemented effective safety measures and that the claims made by the attorneys general are unsupported.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የ29 ግዛቶች ጥምረት ሜታ በፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም አፕሊኬሽኖች አማካኝነት የወጣቶችን የአእምሮ ጤና እንደጎዳ በመክሰስ የፍርድ ሂደት ጀምሯል። ግዛቶቹ ሜታ ትርፍ ለማግኘት ሲል ታዳጊዎችን ሱስ ውስጥ እንዲገቡ ማድረጉንና ህገ-ወጥ መረጃዎችን መሰብሰቡን ይከሳሉ። ሜታ በበኩሉ ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ኩባንያው ለወጣቶች ደህንነት ሲባል የተለያዩ ጥበቃዎችን ተግባራዊ ማድረጉን ይከራከራል።
oromo: Mootummoonni 29 gara US-tti dhaabbata Meta irratti himata bananii jiru; himatichi Meta 'Facebook' fi 'Instagram' fayyadamuun fayyaa sammuu dargaggootaa miidhuu fi akka isaan harka keessa galan godhuudha. Himattonni akka jedhanitti, dhaabbatichi bu'aa qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuun ijoollee gahuufi ragaalee isaanii seeraan alatti akka walitti qabu himatu. Meta gamasaatiin, himanni kun dhugaa akka hin qabnee fi ijoolleen akka hin miidhamneef tarkaanfiileen eegumsaa gara garaa fudhatamuu isaa dubbata.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza City cafe kills six, including child
english: An Israeli military airstrike targeted a cafe in Gaza City, resulting in the deaths of six Palestinians, among them one child. Several other people sustained injuries during the attack, which witnesses say caused some victims to be thrown into the sea. While the strike caused civilian casualties, Israeli officials claimed they were aiming to hit four Hamas commanders.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ ካፌ ላይ ተፈጽሞ አንድ ህጻንን ጨምሮ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ ሰዎችን የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ ተጎጂዎች በፈንጂው ኃይል ወደ ባህር እንደተወረወሩ ተዘግቧል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው አራት የሃማስ አዛዦችን ለመምታት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti kaafé tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwataniin, mucaa tokko dabalatee namoonni ja'a lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni biroon hedduun miidhaniiru; namoonni miidhamanis humna dhoohichaan gara galaanaatti darbatamuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa. Israa'el gama ishee, haleellaa kana kan raawwatte ajootoota Hamas afur irratti xiyyeeffachuun akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
english: A 4.8 magnitude earthquake struck near the historic city of Granada in southern Spain, causing minor injuries to three people and damaging buildings and vehicles. The tremor, which occurred on Tuesday morning, is part of a series of recent seismic activities in the region. Several public facilities, including the famous Alhambra palace, have temporarily closed as officials assess the damage.
amharic: የ4.8 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በደቡባዊ ስፔን ታሪካዊቷ ግራናዳ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ተከስቶ በሶስት ሰዎች ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት እንዲሁም በህንፃዎች እና በተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ማክሰኞ ጠዋት የተከሰተው ይህ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በአካባቢው በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ተከታታይነት ያላቸው ተመሳሳይ እንቅስቃሴዎች አካል ነው። ባለስልጣናት ጉዳቱን እየገመገሙ በመሆኑ የታዋቂው አልሃምብራ ቤተመንግስትን ጨምሮ በርካታ የህዝብ ተቋማት ለጊዜው ተዘግተዋል።
oromo: Sochiin lafaa hamma 4.8 qabu magaalaa seena-qabeettii Ispeen Granada biratti mudateen namoota sadii irratti miidhaan salphaan gahee, manneenii fi konkolaatonni miidhamaniiru. Roobii ganama kan mudate sochiin lafaa kun, guyyoota darban keessa naannichatti sochiileen lafaa walitti aansuun mudataa turan keessaa tokko. Bulchiistonni miidhaa qaqqabe qorachaa waan jiraniif, gamoon seena-qabeessi Alhambra dabalatee dhaabbileen ummataa muraasni yeroof cufamaniiru.

title: US mother begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
english: During the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children, family members testified that she was actively seeking medical help for her deteriorating mental health. While the prosecution argues the killings were intentional, the defense maintains that she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Witnesses described Clancy as a loving mother who felt distressed and unlike herself in the months leading up to the tragedy.
amharic: ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችው ሊንዚ ክላንሲ፣ አሳዛኙ ድርጊት ከመፈጸሙ በፊት የአእምሮ ጤንነቷ እየተጎዳ እንደነበርና ለህክምና እርዳታ ትማጸን እንደነበር የቤተሰብ አባላት በችሎት መስክረዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ግድያው ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ሲከራከር፣ የመከላከያ ጠበቆች ግን እናትየው በወቅቱ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የወሊድ ጭንቀት (postpartum psychosis) ውስጥ እንደነበረች ይናገራሉ። ምስክሮችም ሊንዚ አፍቃሪ እናት እንደነበረችና ከወሊድ በኋላ በነበሩት ወራት ውስጥ በራሷ ላይ የነበረው ለውጥ ግራ እንዳጋባት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mucoolii ishee sadii ajjeesuun kan himatamte Lindsay Clancy, balaan kun osoo hin ta'in dura fayyaan ishee sammuu akka hir'ateef gargaarsa gaafachaa akka turte miseensonni maatii ishee mana murtii irratti dhugoomsaniiru. Abbaan alangaa ajjeechaan sun yaadamee kan raawwatame dha jedhee yoo falmu, gorsitoonni ittisaa garuu haati kun yeroo sana rakkoo sammuu kan da'umsa boodaa (postpartum psychosis) cimaa keessa akka turte dubbatu. Ragaaleen akka ibsanitti, Lindsay haadha jaalala qabdu turte, garuu erga da'ee booda rakkoo ishee mudateen of wallaaltee akka turte dubbataniiru.

title: Police attack Indonesian student protesters, arresting at least 21
english: Hundreds of university students gathered in Jakarta to demonstrate against government policies shortly after Indonesia's Independence Day celebrations. Security forces confronted the protesters, leading to violent clashes between the two groups. At least 21 students were taken into custody by police during the incident.
amharic: ኢንዶኔዢያ የነጻነት በዓሏን ካከበረች አንድ ቀን በኋላ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች በመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ለመቃወም በጃካርታ አደባባይ ወጥተው ነበር። ተቃውሞው ወደ ግጭት በማምራቱ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በወሰዱት እርምጃ ቢያንስ 21 ተማሪዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa bilisummaa Indoneeziya kabajee guyyaa tokko booda, barattoonni yunivarsitii dhibbaan lakkaa'aman siyaasa mootummaa mormuuf magaala Jakartatti hiriira ba'an. Hiririchi gara walitti bu'iinsaatti jijjiiramee, humnoonni nageenyaa namoota yoo xiqqaate 21 ta'an to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Barcelona seal deal for World Cup winner Rodri from Manchester City
english: FC Barcelona has officially signed Spanish star midfielder Rodri from Manchester City for 76.5 million euros. The 30-year-old, who was recently named the best player of the World Cup, has committed to a contract that lasts until 2030. He joins his international teammates in Barcelona, expressing his excitement to play for the Catalan club after completing his medical exams.
amharic: ኤፍ ሲ ባርሴሎና የስፔኑን ኮከብ አማካኝ ሮድሪን ከማንቸስተር ሲቲ በ76.5 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በይፋ አስፈርሟል። የ30 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች በቅርቡ የአለም ዋንጫ ኮከብ ተጫዋች በመሆን የተመረጠ ሲሆን እስከ 2030 የሚቆይ ውል ተፈራርሟል። ሮድሪ ወደ ባርሴሎና በመቀላቀሉ የተሰማውን ደስታ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ የህክምና ምርመራውን በማጠናቀቅ ከስፔን ብሄራዊ ቡድን አጋሮቹ ጋር ተቀላቅሏል።
oromo: FC Barcelona taphataa giddu galeessa biyya Spain kan ta'e Rodri Manchester City irraa qarshii yuroo miliyoona 76.5n ifatti mallatteessiseera. Taphataan umurii 30 kun, kan dhiheenya kana taphataa guddicha wancaa addunyaa ta'ee badhaafame, hanga bara 2030tti turuuf waliigaltee raawwateera. Rodri garee Barcelona kanatti makamuusaatiin gammachuu isaa ibsee, qormaata fayyaa booda hiriyoota garee biyyaalessaa isaa waliin leenjii jalqabuuf qophii ta'uu beeksiseera.

title: Nigeria hospital collapses after rain washed away its foundations
english: A hospital building in Nigeria recently collapsed after heavy rains caused a landslide that undermined its structure. Fortunately, local residents noticed warning signs beforehand, which allowed for the successful evacuation of everyone inside. No casualties were reported as a result of the incident.

title: Analysis: Syrian airbase attack is an Israeli message to Damascus, Ankara
english: Recent Israeli airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria are viewed by experts as a deliberate warning to prevent the new Syrian government from restoring its aerial military capabilities. By targeting key infrastructure, Israel aims to maintain regional dominance and signal its disapproval to both Damascus and its ally, Turkiye. These actions reflect Israel's ongoing efforts to weaken Syrian military strength and influence in the post-Assad era.

title: The British state has recast protest as terrorism
english: British legislation now defines property damage committed for political or ideological reasons as terrorism, significantly expanding the scope of counterterrorism laws beyond violent acts. Critics, including legal experts and human rights advocates, argue this broad interpretation unfairly equates civil protest and activism with criminal terrorism. This shift has fundamentally changed how the government and courts interact with demonstrators and political dissenters in the UK.

title: Iran prepares to keep economy alive as US threatens further sanctions
english: The United States is preparing to impose unprecedented economic sanctions against Iran as part of an ongoing naval blockade and trade embargo. In response, Iranian officials are maintaining a defiant stance, suggesting they may shift toward offensive military operations to challenge the restrictions. Experts note that Tehran currently appears more likely to prioritize breaking the blockade through conflict rather than surrendering to American terms.

title: Disney sues US regulator, claiming political retaliation over ABC stations
english: Disney has filed a lawsuit against the Federal Communications Commission, accusing the Trump administration of using license renewal requirements to punish ABC for its news coverage. The network claims the government is attempting to intimidate them due to political frustration with their reporting and commentary. While the FCC argues the decision relates to internal company practices, Disney maintains that the early review is a retaliatory move meant to undermine their journalistic independence.

title: Two children shot by Israeli forces in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid on the Am’ari refugee camp in the occupied West Bank on Tuesday. During the operation, soldiers opened fire on two children, leaving one of them in serious condition. Palestinian medical personnel confirmed the incident occurred in the el-Bireh area near Ramallah.

title: UAE says Iran fired two ballistic missiles at territory
english: The United Arab Emirates defense ministry reported that two ballistic missiles launched from Iran were detected heading toward their territory on Tuesday. One missile landed outside the country's territorial waters, while the second fell within them. UAE officials stated that they remain on high alert and are fully prepared to address any further security threats.
