title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
english: A ferry accident on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has claimed 93 lives, marking the country's worst transport tragedy. The vessel was significantly overloaded with passengers and cargo when it capsized due to strong waves, making life-saving equipment inaccessible. Search efforts are ongoing, though authorities now face challenges identifying victims due to the condition of the bodies and may require DNA testing.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ የደረሰው የጀልባ አደጋ 93 ሰዎችን በመቅጠፍ የአገሪቱ እጅግ አሳዛኝ የመጓጓዣ አደጋ ሆኗል። ጀልባዋ ከተፈቀደላት አቅም በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን እና እቃዎችን ጭና በመጓዝ ላይ ሳለች በጠንካራ ማዕበል ተገልብጣለች። የነፍስ አድን ስራው እየቀጠለ ቢሆንም፣ የሟቾችን ማንነት ለመለየት አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ የዲኤንኤ ምርመራ ሊያስፈልግ እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa fi biyyoota ollaa keessatti balaan markabaa haro Karibaa keessatti mudate lubbuu namoota 93 kan galaafate yoo ta'u, kun balaa geejjiba biyyattii keessatti mudate keessaa isa hamaadha. Markabatti namoota hedduu fi meeshaalee baay'ee fe'uun isaa fi qilleensi cimaan akka inni gombifamu taasiseera. Hojii barbaacha fi foon namoota du'anii funaanuu ammayyuu kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, qaamni namoota du'anii adda baasuun rakkisaa waan ta'eef qorannoon DNA barbaachisuu danda'a.

title: Real Madrid officially present Mourinho in bizarre closed-door ceremony
english: Jose Mourinho has officially returned to Real Madrid as manager, signing a contract that keeps him with the club until 2029. Unlike the usual grand presentations, his appointment was marked by a quiet, private ceremony at the team's training facility. Mourinho expressed that coming back feels deeply personal and emotional as he looks to lead the team following a period of high-profile new signings and trophy droughts.
amharic: ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሪያል ማድሪድ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በይፋ ተሹመዋል። አሰልጣኙ እስከ 2029 ዓ.ም የሚያቆያቸውን ውል የተፈራረሙ ሲሆን፣ የዝግጅቱ አቀራረብ ከተለመደው ትልቅ ደማቅ ስነ-ስርዓት በተለየ መልኩ በለስላሳ እና በግል የተከናወነ ነበር። ሞሪንሆ ወደ ክለቡ መመለሳቸው ትልቅ ስሜታዊ ትርጉም እንዳለው ገልጸው፣ በክለቡ ላይ የነበረውን የዋንጫ ድርቅ ለመስበር ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Jose Mourinho yeroo lammaffaaf leenjisaa Real Madrid ta'uun isaanii ifa ta'eera, kanaanis hanga bara 2029 turuuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru. Sirni beekamtii isaa kan duraan akka amala Real Madrid'tti mallattoo guddaa hin qabne, kanaa mannaa iddoo leenjiitti haala calliinsaan raawwatameera. Mourinho gara Real Madrid deebi'uun isaa miira guddaa akka isaaf qabu ibsuun, garee kana keessatti milkaa'ina haaraa galmeessisuuf akka hojjetu dubbateera.

title: Spain builds tent cities for the thousands stuck in Ceuta
english: Spain is establishing four temporary tent settlements in Ceuta to provide shelter for approximately 1,500 migrants. This move follows a massive influx of over 72,000 people from Morocco in July, leaving thousands currently stranded in the city. Many of these individuals are residing in improvised camps on beaches while hoping to secure employment within Europe.
amharic: ስፔን በሴውታ ከተማ ለተጠለሉ ወደ 1,500 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች መጠለያ እንዲሆን አራት ጊዜያዊ የድንኳን ከተሞችን እየገነባች ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ ከሞሮኮ ከ72,000 በላይ ሰዎች ድንበር ተሻግረው በመግባታቸው ሳቢያ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት በከተማዋ የቀሩት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች በአውሮፓ ውስጥ ሥራ ለማግኘት በመጠባበቅ ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ አብዛኛዎቹም በባህር ዳርቻዎች በተዘጋጁ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ ይኖራሉ።
oromo: Ispeeniin godaantota gara 1,500 ta'anf magaalaa Se'utaa keessatti lafa dunkaanotaa yeroo arfanii ijaaraa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame ji'a Adoolessaa keessa namoonni 72,000 ol ta'an biyya Morookoo irraa daangaa ce'anii seenuun isaanii hordofee dha. Namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ammas magaala kana keessatti kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis Awurooppaa keessatti hojii argachuuf abdii qabachaa, bakkeewwan yeroo qarqara galaanaatti ijaaraman keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: Palestinian living in caves older than Israel
english: Farhan al Rashaydeh and his family reside in a cave located in the occupied West Bank. Although they have grown fond of their home, they were forced to live there because Israeli authorities rarely grant Palestinians permission to build houses. This situation highlights the significant challenges Palestinians face due to strict construction regulations in the region.
amharic: ፋርሃን አል-ራሻይዴህ እና ቤተሰቡ በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ዋሻ ውስጥ ይኖራሉ። ምንም እንኳን ቤታቸውን ቢወዱትም፣ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ጥብቅ የህንጻ ግንባታ ህግ ምክንያት ፍቃድ ማግኘት ስላልቻሉ በዋሻው ውስጥ ለመኖር ተገደዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚደርሰውን የቤት ግንባታ ተግዳሮት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Farhaan Al-Rashaaydeh fi maatiin isaa qarqara ganda Weest Baank keessatti holqa keessa jiraatu. Manasaanii kana jaallatanis, mootummaan Israa'el hayyama ijaarsa manaa akka hin kennineef dirqamanii holqa keessa jiraachuu filataniiru. Haalli kun rakkina ijoolleen Falasxiin seera ijaarsa manaa cimaa ta'een kanneen mudatan mul'isa.

title: “I fear for my family’s lives” says Loui Ridi as settlers besiege home
english: Loui Ridi, a Palestinian-American, is fearing for his family’s safety as Israeli settlers surround their home in Qusra. The settlers have already seized a neighbor's property and are moving through the area without facing any opposition. Ridi has displayed an American flag outside his house in an urgent attempt to draw attention and support from United States authorities.
amharic: ፓሌስታናዊ አሜሪካዊው ሉዊ ሪዲ በኩስራ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ላይ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ከበው በመገኘታቸው ለቤተሰባቸው ደህንነት እንደሚሰጉ ተናግረዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ቀደም ሲል የጎረቤታቸውን ቤት ተቆጣጥረው ያለ ምንም ተቃውሞ በአካባቢው እየተንቀሳቀሱ ይገኛሉ። ሪዲ የአሜሪካን ባንዲራ በቤታቸው ላይ በማውለብለብ ከአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ፈጣን ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Namni lammii Amerikaa fi Palastiinii ta'e Loui Ridi, qubsattoonni Israa'el mana isaa kan Qusra keessatti argamu marsuun isaanii maatii isaa irratti soda guddaa uumeera. Qubsattoonni kunneen mana ollaa isaa to'annaa jala galchuun, sodaa tokko malee naannichatti socho'aa jiru. Ridi, gargaarsa mootummaa Amerikaa argachuuf jecha alaabaa Amerikaa manasaa irratti olcheera.

title: Six killed in Israeli air strike on Gaza City, including a child
english: At least six people, including a child, were killed in an Israeli air strike targeting a cafe in Gaza City. The force of the attack knocked several victims into the sea, prompting an ongoing search and recovery operation. Additionally, about a dozen people were injured in the strike and are receiving medical treatment at al-Shifa Hospital.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ ካፌ ላይ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ህጻንን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የጥቃቱ አሰቃቂነት በርካታ ሰዎችን ወደ ባህር ውስጥ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ የአስከሬን ፍለጋ ስራዎች በመካሄድ ላይ ይገኛሉ። እንዲሁም በአስራ ሁለት የሚገመቱ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በአል-ሺፋ ሆስፒታል ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gaazaatti kaafe tokko irratti xiyyaarri waraana Israa'el erga haleelee booda, ijoollee dabalatee namoonni jahaan lubbuun darbaniiru. Humna haleellaa kanaan namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e tokko tokko gara galaanaatti darbatamanii jiru; kanaafis hojiin reeffa barbaaduu itti fufee jira. Kanas malee, namoonni kudha lama ta'an miidhamanii hospitaala Al-Shifaa keessatti yaalamaa jiru.

title: Yemeni forces shoot down Houthi drone in Hadramout
english: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, successfully intercepted and destroyed a suspected Houthi drone near a military base in the Hadramout region. Simultaneously, the Yemeni government launched its own series of drone strikes targeting Houthi strongholds across multiple areas in the Shabwa governorate. These events mark a continuation of the ongoing military tensions between the two opposing sides in Yemen.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ የምትደግፈው የየመን መንግስት ኃይሎች በሐድራሙት ክልል አቅራቢያ የተጠረጠረ የሁቲ ድሮን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ የየመን መንግስት በሻብዋ ግዛት በሚገኙ የሁቲዎች ይዞታዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን መፈጸሙን ገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት ተባብሶ መቀጠሉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen, kan Saudi Arabia deggartu, naannoo Hadramuutitti xiyyara malee kan Houthi jedhame shakkiin qabame tokko rukutanii kuffisaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, mootummaan Yemen naannoo Shabwaa keessatti bakkeewwan loltoota Houthi irratti haleellaa xiyyara malee gaggeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa mootummaa fi garee Houthi gidduutti adeemaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: US cites India on voter IDs, but are elections under Modi clean?
english: US President Donald Trump is citing India’s mandatory photo identification system as a model to advocate for stricter voting laws in the United States. While he points to India's efficient handling of a massive electorate, critics note that the Indian election process faces significant concerns regarding institutional independence and fairness under Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Consequently, experts warn that using India's model may overlook the deeper complexities and ongoing controversies surrounding the integrity of its democratic processes.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሕንድ የሚተገበረውን የግዴታ መታወቂያ ስርዓት በአሜሪካ የበለጠ ጥብቅ የምርጫ ሕጎችን ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ እንደ ምሳሌ እየጠቀሱት ይገኛል። ምንም እንኳን የሕንድ ምርጫ በስፋቱ የሚደነቅ ቢሆንም፣ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ አስተዳደር ሥር የምርጫ ተቋማት ነፃነት እና ፍትሃዊነት አጠያያቂ መሆኑን ብዙዎች ይገልጻሉ። በዚህም ምክንያት የሕንድን ሞዴል መጥቀስ በዚያ አገር ውስጥ ያሉትን የዲሞክራሲ እና የምርጫ ሂደት ተግዳሮቶች ችላ የማለት ዕድል እንዳለው ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, sirni galmee eenyummaa Hindii kan dirqama ta'e, biyya isaanii keessatti seera filannoo jabeesuuf akka fakkeenyaatti fayyadamaa jiru. Filannoon Hindii bal'inaan kan dinqisiifamu ta'us, bulchiinsa Ministira Muummee Naareendiraa Moodii jalatti mirgi fi walabummaan dhaabbilee filannoo gaaffii keessa galeera. Kanaafuu, namoonni dhimma kana hordofan akka jedhanitti, fakkeenya Hindii kana fayyadamuun rakkoolee diimookiraasii fi amanamummaa filannoo biyyattii keessa jiran dagachuu ta'uu danda'a.

title: Why is Russia threatening UK with ‘consequences’ over Ukraine drones?
english: Russia has warned the United Kingdom of potential retaliation after reports emerged that British-made drones are being used by Ukraine to target locations deep inside Russian territory. Moscow accuses London of escalating the conflict and acting as an accomplice to these attacks, while suggesting that Western support for Ukraine will lead to severe repercussions. Although the UK has not officially confirmed supplying these specific weapons, Russian officials suggest their military could potentially strike back against British interests.

title: Israeli soldiers number Palestinian detainees on their foreheads
english: During a military operation in the West Bank town of Qabatiya, Israeli forces detained dozens of Palestinian residents, including women. Those captured were subsequently taken away by the military for questioning.

title: Trump says no talks are taking place with Iran
english: President Donald Trump has clarified that the United States is not currently holding any discussions with Iran. He further noted that no future meetings between the two nations have been planned. Additionally, he emphasized that the military blockade around the Strait of Hormuz continues to be actively enforced.

title: Saudi Arabia tightens rules on financial transfers to UAE
english: Saudi Arabia has quietly implemented stricter regulations on financial transfers to the UAE, effectively categorizing the country as a high-risk jurisdiction for money laundering. Business owners report that their transactions are frequently being blocked or delayed by Saudi banks, indicating a growing economic impact from the ongoing political rift between the two Gulf nations. While both governments officially deny the existence of specific restrictions, these measures reflect deepening tensions involving geopolitical disagreements over regional conflicts.
